result.note: Tests the August 2026 addition of caste to the Census 2027 survey and its first-since-independence status.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, the government announced a change to the Census 2027. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It will be the second caste count conducted since independence.
Caste was added as a question to its 40-question survey.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong because the story calls it the first caste count since independence, not the second. Caste was added to the 40-question Census 2027 survey, giving every side a hard figure to organise around and straining the BJP's broad Hindu coalition.
questions.source: The government added caste to the 40-question Census 2027 survey, the first caste count since independence
